title: Adjust your Logitech Webcam Settings for Better Images
description: Gain more control over your Logitech webcam (my favorite: https://amzn.to/2SZACLV AD) using the Logitech Gaming Software (https://support.logitech.com/en_us/software/lgs). In this video, I'm going to show you how to adjust your webcam settings using free software that you can download straight from Logitech's website.  Just head over to https://www.logitech.com and search for the Logitech Gaming Software and download the version that's compatible with your platform/OS.  The software works with the webcam that I have, which is a C922, but I'm pretty sure it also works fine with a C920, 925 or 930.  Before you launch the application you're using to record a video (ex. Quicktime or ScreenFlow), make sure to adjust the settings accordingly.  Go to Advanced Settings, Webcam Control - Untick the Auto checkbox for 'Exposure' and adjust the exposure accordingly. - You can also untick the Focus - Adjust the rest of the settings according to your preferences and hit save.
